newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 6.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 6.

text.p: -- Cisco Systems Inc reported fourth quarter pro forma earnings of $0.55 per share versus $0.42 per share in the same quarter last year, in line with Wall Street estimates but below the "whisper" number. The stock, which closed at 81-15/16, fell as low as 79-5/8 in after-hours trading.
-- Viasoft Inc reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.22 per share compared to $0.13 per share in last year's fourth quarter. The stock closed at 64, then dipped to 63 in after-hours trading.

-- Boeing Co is likely to get a big order for a batch of passenger planes from China before a U.S.-China presidential summit in October, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing Chinese government officials. Boeing stock closed at 58-1/8.

-- Apple Computer Inc's head scientist, Lawrence Tesler, has left the computer maker for a startup software company just as Apple is about to unveil new products and a new business strategy. The stock closed at 19-12/16.
